title: Support admin rights on the customer database are misused or abused after account compromise
threat: External attacker using a phished support account; careless or malicious insider
weakness: Support staff hold admin rights on A-02 (deliberate weak spot; POL-04 known gap); no MFA; no database activity logging
consequence: Bulk export, change or deletion of all customer records; notifiable breach affecting about 20,000 customers
existing_controls: Named (not shared) support accounts; laptop password login
acceptance: Temporary exception accepted by Managing Director until 2026-11-24 (POL-04 known gap; shortened from 2026-12-15 after INC-01)
rescore_basis: Risk materialised as INC-01. Containment (CA-22, CA-23, CA-25) only closes two web endpoints and one password; the root causes remain open: support still holds admin rights on A-02 (CA-01), shared account, no MFA (CA-02), tokens survive password resets (CA-24). The CA-23 reset was undone once by a restart

title: Phishing compromises staff accounts and laptops
threat: Phishing email with credential harvesting or malware
weakness: No awareness training; no MFA; no endpoint detection and response
consequence: Attacker gains email access, support access to A-02 and cached customer data on A-04
existing_controls: Email provider spam filter; built-in antivirus
rescore_basis: No new evidence; phishing is the assumed INC-01 entry point and training (CA-04) has not started; Phase 2 score kept

title: Known vulnerabilities in outdated web shop components are exploited
weakness: Ad hoc patching; no vulnerability scanning; no inventory of third-party libraries
consequence: Compromise of A-01 with possible pivot to A-02; data theft; shop outage
acceptance: Temporary exception accepted by Managing Director until 2026-11-24 (CA-21 due; Critical after re-scoring)
rescore_basis: Trivy (CA-05) confirms 116 known CVEs in the shop's libraries, 7 Critical, including authentication bypasses (CVE-2015-9235 jsonwebtoken, CVE-2020-15084 express-jwt). Impact raised to 5 because forged tokens would give access to every account. CA-21 is open until 2026-11-24 and a WAF cannot block forged tokens

title: Privileged IT administrator account is compromised
threat: Phishing; password reuse; session token theft
weakness: No MFA; admin rights used from everyday accounts; no separate admin accounts
consequence: Full control of A-01, A-02, A-03 and the cloud console; mass data theft or destruction
rescore_basis: No new evidence on admin accounts; INC-01 showed that issued tokens survive a password reset (CA-24 open), which supports the Phase 2 score

title: Ransomware encrypts the customer database and its backups
threat: Ransomware deployed through compromised admin or support access
weakness: Backups in the same cloud account; not immutable; restore never tested
consequence: Multi-day shop outage, loss of orders, extortion, and a personal data breach
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Cloud misconfiguration exposes the database or backups to the internet
threat: Misconfigured storage or firewall rule found by internet-wide scanning
weakness: No configuration baseline or review; backups not encrypted
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Credential stuffing takes over customer accounts
threat: Bots replaying leaked email and password lists
weakness: No login rate limiting; no breached-password check; no customer 2FA
consequence: Account takeover, fraudulent orders, exposure of address and contact data
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Lost or stolen laptop discloses cached customer data
threat: Theft or loss during remote work
weakness: No full-disk encryption; no remote wipe
consequence: Disclosure of cached customer records; notifiable breach
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Breach at the delivery partner exposes customer names and addresses
threat: Attack on the delivery partner's systems
weakness: No supplier assessment; more data shared than needed (email)
consequence: Disclosure of names and addresses; phishing of customers in ShopNova's name
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Suppliers process personal data without GDPR-compliant agreements
weakness: No Art. 28 agreement with A-06 or the hosting provider; roles of A-05 and A-08 not assessed
consequence: Unlawful processing; orders and fines under Art. 83(4) GDPR
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: A personal data breach is not detected or not notified within 72 hours
weakness: No central logging; no incident response plan; no breach procedure
consequence: Late or missed Art. 33 notification, more harm to customers, higher fines
rescore_basis: INC-01 exercise: detection 18 s after the attack, notification decision 55 s after awareness, all Art. 33 milestones met. Not lower than 2 because the lab compresses time, the detection rules cover only a few patterns and no SIEM is in production

title: SQL injection in the web shop exposes the customer database
threat: Attacker submits crafted input to shop forms or URLs
weakness: Queries built by string concatenation; no security testing; no WAF
consequence: Dump of all customer records including password hashes; about 20,000 customers; Art. 33 and 34 notifications
rescore_basis: The SQL injection in the login (V-01) is fixed and verified: the same attack fails and the ZAP active scan finds nothing. Not lower than 2 because only the login request was scanned; other input fields were not tested and the WAF (CA-07) is not deployed

title: Malicious script on the checkout page skims payment details
threat: Compromised third-party JavaScript or injected script on A-01
weakness: No Content Security Policy; no Subresource Integrity; no script monitoring
consequence: Card data and identity theft, fraud, sanctions from the payment provider
existing_controls: Card entry in fields hosted by the payment provider (assumption)
rescore_basis: CSP deployed (V-02, CA-16 in progress), but scripts from cdnjs are still allowed without Subresource Integrity and there is no script monitoring; Phase 2 score kept

title: Customer data is kept longer than its retention period
weakness: No deletion job; backups keep deleted data
consequence: Breach of storage limitation (Art. 5(1)(e)); larger impact of any breach
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Data subject requests are not answered within one month
weakness: No data subject request procedure or log
consequence: Complaints to the BlnBDI, orders, fines under Art. 83(5) GDPR
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Newsletter consent records are lost at the email provider
threat: Data loss or account deletion at the provider
weakness: Proof of consent held only at A-06
consequence: Consent cannot be proven (Art. 7(1)); newsletter must stop until consent is renewed
acceptance: Accepted by Marketing Lead (Low: within appetite under POL-09)
rescore_basis: No new evidence: not tested in the lab; Phase 2 score kept

title: Web shop misconfiguration exposes internal files, access logs and cross-origin data
threat: Opportunistic attacker or automated scanner browsing the shop (robots.txt points to /ftp)
weakness: Directory listing of /ftp; public access logs at /support/logs; wildcard CORS header; missing security headers
consequence: Disclosure of confidential business documents and of access logs with customer IP addresses; cross-origin reading of API responses
existing_controls: None (found by the Phase 3 scans on 2026-11-17)
rescore_basis: Wildcard CORS removed and /ftp, /support/logs, /encryptionkeys blocked; verified by the ZAP baseline rescan and manual checks (HTTP 403)
